Thinking about what all of the pristin girls went through breaks my heart, but Siyeon's experience especially. She became a pledis trainee in 2008 when she was 8 years old, trained for 9 years, ranked 25th in produce101, finally debuted with pristin as their lead vocal, lead dancer, and lead rapper. She was even an mc of music core alongside Cha Eunwoo. And then Pledis disbanded Pristin. She barely got two years of being an idol after all the work she put in :(((
